findings.description: AWS access key material is embedded in Lambda environment variables in Terraform. This exposes credentials through source control, Terraform state, and Lambda configuration access, and enables unauthorized AWS API access if the key is valid.
The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime, which no longer receives security updates and increases exposure to known runtime vulnerabilities.
